description: The plot illustrates the loss over the number of iterations for different configurations of the SepLLM model. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 95,000 to 125,000, with tick labels at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.0 to 3.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four lines representing different model configurations: SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) in pink, SepLLM (n=128) in blue, SepLLM (n=64) in orange, and a dashed red line representing a baseline or control. The pink line starts at a loss of approximately 2.8 and decreases to around 2.2 by the end of the iterations. The blue line starts at a loss of approximately 2.9 and decreases to around 2.3. The orange line starts at a loss of approximately 2.8 and decreases to around 2.2. The dashed red line remains constant at a loss of 2.2 throughout the iterations.
